运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

初始化输出与 x 一致，门控偏置有梯度；打开分支后仅被修改条件的样本输出改变，条件梯度非零。

python 21_conditioning-fusion_demo.py环境配置

零门控 AdaLN：观察身份映射和条件路径

21_conditioning-fusion_demo.py
# [1] 条件参数在每个样本内广播，B 与 T 特意不同import torchfrom torch import nntorch.manual_seed(40) class ConditionalBlock(nn.Module):    def __init__(self, dim=4, condition_dim=2):        super().__init__()        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim,elementwise_affine=False)        self.modulate = nn.Sequential(nn.SiLU(),nn.Linear(condition_dim,3*dim))        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(dim,8),nn.SiLU(),nn.Linear(8,dim))        nn.init.zeros_(self.modulate[-1].weight)        nn.init.zeros_(self.modulate[-1].bias)     def forward(self,x,condition):        scale,shift,gate = self.modulate(condition).chunk(3,dim=-1)        normalized = self.norm(x)        h = normalized*(1+scale[:,None,:])+shift[:,None,:]        return x + gate[:,None,:]*self.ffn(h) # [2] 零门控保持恒等；先检查门控层而不是要求所有梯度非零model = ConditionalBlock()x = torch.randn(2,3,4)condition = torch.randn(2,2,requires_grad=True)initial = model(x,condition)torch.testing.assert_close(initial,x)initial.square().mean().backward()assert model.modulate[-1].bias.grad[-4:].norm() > 0torch.testing.assert_close(condition.grad,torch.zeros_like(condition))print("初始恒等与门控梯度正确") # [3] 打开条件分支后，只改变第一个样本的条件with torch.no_grad():    nn.init.normal_(model.modulate[-1].weight,std=0.1)    model.modulate[-1].bias[-4:].fill_(0.2)changed = condition.detach().clone()changed[0,0] += 1.0before,after = model(x,condition),model(x,changed)torch.testing.assert_close(before[1],after[1])assert not torch.allclose(before[0],after[0])model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)condition.grad = Nonemodel(x,condition).square().mean().backward()assert condition.grad is not None and condition.grad.norm() > 0print("条件只影响相应样本，打开分支后梯度能够回到条件")
